y-m-10-01.title: Lilipi ilali elinabantu abaninzi?
y-m-10-01.topic: Ukuthelekisa amanani amakhulu (inani lamanani, emva koko ukuthelekisa ukusuka kwindawo ephezulu)
y-m-10-01.goal: Cacisa indlela ubukhulu bumiselwa ngayo xa amanani enamanani ahlukeneyo, nokuba linani leyiphi indawo elimisela isiphumo xa enamanani alinganayo. Misela into ekufuneka uyazi ukuze uthelekise xa inani elinye lifihliwe.
y-m-10-01.material: Ufuna ukuthelekisa inani labantu abahlala eKhalali yaseGaram (가람마을) naseNarae (나래마을). Amanani asebhodini onke ngamanani emvelo, abhalwe ngekoma (,) emva kwamanani amathathu ngamathathu, yaye inani lokuqala alingo-0. Iyunithi yi-'명' (abantu).
y-m-10-01.thinking.0: Ukumisela ukuba ulwazi luyaneliseka ukuthelekisa na
y-m-10-01.thinking.1: Cacisa, usebenzisa isivakalisi esithi ukuba-ngoko, isizathu sokuba sithelekise ukusuka kwindawo ephezulu
y-m-10-01.prereq.0: Amaxabiso eendawo nokufundwa kwamanani amakhulu ukuya kwizigidi (inqanaba lebanga 4)
y-m-10-01.prereq.1: Ukufunda amanani abhalwe ngekoma emva kwamanani amathathu ngamathathu
y-m-10-01.s.s1.prompt: Kuqala, imeko apho onke amanani abonakalayo. IGaram inabantu abangama-987,654 (amawaka angamakhulu alithoba anamashumi asibhozo anesixhenxe, amakhulu amathandathu anamashumi amahlanu anesine) yaye iNarae inabantu abangama-1,000,000 (isigidi esinye). Lilipi ilali elinabantu abaninzi?
y-m-10-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bala amanani ukubona ukuba inani ngalinye linamanani amangaphi.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba kufuneka udibanise malini kwi-987,654 ukufumana i-1,000,000, uze ujonge umahluko phakathi kwamanani amabini.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.o.a: IGaram. Amanani amakhulu njenge-9, 8, 7 aza kuqala, ngoko likhulu
y-m-10-01.s.s1.r.a: Ujonge ukuba amanani okuqala makhulu kangakanani. Hlola ukuba indlela efanayo isebenza xa amanani amabini enamanani alinganayo nxa enamanani ahlukeneyo.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.o.b: INarae. IGaram inenani elinamanani ama-6 yaye iNarae inenani elinamanani ama-7
y-m-10-01.s.s1.r.b: Le yingcamango yokubala inani lamanani kuqala, kunokujonga inani ngalinye.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.o.c: Asinakumisela. Amaqela ahlulwe ngekoma ahluke ngenani, ngoko awanakuthelekiswa
y-m-10-01.s.s1.r.c: Ucinge ukuba amanani awanakuthelekiswa ukuba amaqela ekoma ayahluka. Ikoma ziimpawu kuphela ezenza amanani abe lula ukufunda. Cinga ukuba yintoni emisela ubukhulu benani.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.explain: Kumanani emvelo anenani lokuqala elingo-0, elinamanani amaninzi likhulu. I-987,654 linani elinamanani ama-6 yaye i-1,000,000 linani elinamanani ama-7. Nokuba amanani angaphambili 9, 8, 7 abonakala makhulu, akuncedi. Ungahlola oku nangokuba ukudibanisa i-12,346 kwi-987,654 kunika i-1,000,000.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.prompt: Ngeli xesha ibhodi ifumene ibala. IGaram inabantu abangama-3,□45,678 (□ yinani elinye elifihliweyo kwindawo yamakhulu amawaka), yaye iNarae inabantu abangama-3,500,000 (izigidi ezintathu namakhulu amahlanu amawaka). Kufuneka wazi ntoni ukumisela ukuba lilipi ilali elinabantu abaninzi?
y-m-10-01.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala amanani amabini ecaleni kwenye, indawo nganye ukusuka kwindawo ephezulu, uze ufumane indawo yokuqala apho amanani ahluka khona.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ukubeka u-0 no-9 kwi-□ uze uhlole ukuba ukuba lilipi ilali elinabantu abaninzi liyatshintsha na.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.o.a: Inani laseGaram linalo i-45,678 kwinxalenye engasemva yaye inxalenye engasemva yaseNarae ngu-00,000, ngoko iGaram inabantu abaninzi nokuba asilazi i-□
y-m-10-01.s.s2.r.a: Uthelekise amanani ngeenxalenye zawo ezingasemva. Ukuba amanani angaphambili ahluke kwindawo efanayo, iinxalenye ezingasemva azichaphazeli isiphumo. Beka u-0 kwi-□ uze uthelekise ngokuthe ngqo.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.o.b: Unokumisela kuphela ukuba uyayazi ngqo ukuba yintoni i-□
y-m-10-01.s.s2.r.b: Ucinge ukuba kufuneka wazi ixabiso elichanekileyo le-□. Zama ukubeka amanani ambalwa kwi-□ ukuvavanya ukuba ukwazi uluhlu kuphela kwanele ukuthelekisa na.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.o.c: Ukwazi kuphela ukuba i-□ ngu-4 okanye ngaphantsi, okanye ngu-5 okanye ngaphezulu, kwanele ukumisela
y-m-10-01.s.s2.r.c: Ufumene umda apho isiphumo sokuthelekisa sitshintsha khona, waza wachaza ulwazi olufunekayo njenge-'luhlu', hayi njenge-'xabiso'.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.o.d: Nokuba asilazi i-□, thelekisa indawo ye-unithi: u-8 waseGaram mkhulu kuno-0 waseNarae, ngoko iGaram inabantu abaninzi
y-m-10-01.s.s2.r.d: Uthelekise uqala kwindawo esezantsi. Cinga ukuba yiyiphi indawo ekufuneka uyijonge kuqala xa uthelekisa amanani amakhulu.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.explain: Indawo yezigidi kuwo omabini amanani ngu-3, ngoko thelekisa indawo elandelayo, indawo yamakhulu amawaka. INarae inayo u-5. Ukuba i-□ ngu-6~9, iGaram inabantu abaninzi, yaye ukuba i-□ ngu-0~4, iNarae inabantu abaninzi. Ukuba i-□ ngu-5, iindawo zamakhulu amawaka ziyalingana, ngoko jonga indawo elandelayo. Indawo yamashumi amawaka ngu-4 eGaram no-0 eNarae, ngoko iGaram inabantu abaninzi (3,545,678 > 3,500,000). Ngoko nokuba asazi ngqo ukuba i-□ yintoni, ukwazi nje 'ingaba ngu-4 okanye ngaphantsi, okanye ngu-5 okanye ngaphezulu?' kwanele ukumisela.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.prompt: Isiphumo siyatshintsha ngokwenani le-□. Usebenzisa iimeko ezinje 'ukuba i-□ ngu-...', bhala ukuba kwiimeko ezithile iGaram inabantu abaninzi nakwiimeko ezithile iNarae inabantu abaninzi. Bhala nokuba yiyiphi indawo oyithelekisileyo ukumisela oko.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala inani elinalo u-5 kwi-□ nenani laseNarae ecaleni kwenye, uqale kwindawo ephezulu.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kuqala bhala ukuba lilipi ilali elinabantu abaninzi xa i-□ ngu-4 nxa ngu-6.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ujonge ngokwahlukileyo into eyenzekayo xa i-□ ngu-5?
y-m-10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba impendulo yakho ibonisa ucwangciso: indawo yezigidi iyalingana, ngoko kwathelekiswa indawo elandelayo?
y-m-10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba uhlole iimeko zakho ngokubeka amanani okwenyani (umzekelo, u-2 no-7) kwi-□?
y-m-10-01.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba i-□ ngu-5 okanye linani elikhulu, iGaram inabantu abaninzi, yaye ukuba i-□ ngu-4 okanye linani elincinci, iNarae inabantu abaninzi. Indawo yezigidi ngu-3 kuwo omabini, ngoko ndithelekise i-□ kwindawo yamakhulu amawaka no-5.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.model.1: Xa i-□ ingu-4 okanye ngaphantsi, iNarae inabantu abaninzi, yaye xa i-□ isusela ku-5 ukuya ku-9, iGaram inabantu abaninzi. Indawo ephezulu, indawo yezigidi, iyafana, ngoko ndijonge indawo elandelayo.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ayinikezi sizathu sokubandakanya imeko ye-□=5 kwi-5 ukuya ku-9, kodwa ihlula umda ngokuchanekileyo.

y-m-10-02.title: Impendulo kaSeoa: singayithemba na?
y-m-10-02.topic: Ukuhlola isiphumo se-(inani elinamanani amathathu)×(inani elinamanani amabini) (ukuqikelela, inani le-unithi, ukulungelelaniswa kweendawo)
y-m-10-02.goal: Ngaphandle kokuphinda ubale, sebenzisa ukuqikelela nenani le-unithi ukufumana ukuba impendulo ayilunganga, fumana umgca ongalunganga kwisisombululo uze uchaze isizathu, uze wenze ukuphindaphinda kwakho okudlula ukuhlolwa kokukhawuleza kuzo zombini.
y-m-10-02.material: Incwadi enye yokubhala ixabisa i-347 won. Ukufumana ixabiso lezincwadi zokubhala ezingama-23, uSeoa wenza ukuphindaphinda ngokuthe nkqo waza wabhala impendulo i-1,735 won. Ungakubona ukubala kukaSeoa kwinyathelo lesibini. Kuqala, ngaphandle kokuphinda ubale, cinga ukuba le mpendulo ingathenjwa na.

y-m-10-02.prereq.1: Ulwazi lokuqikelela ngamanani aselapha emakhulwini namashumini
y-m-10-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha yonke into onokuyisebenzisa njengobungqina bokuba impendulo kaSeoa i-1,735 won ayilunganga. (Izinto onokuzazi ngaphandle kokuphinda ubale ukusuka ekuqaleni)

y-m-10-02.s.s1.hint.1: Zama ukutshintsha i-347 no-23 zibe ngamanani asondeleyo emakhulwini namashumini, okanye ujonge ukuba isiphumo samanani athile simisela inani le-unithi lesiphumo.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.o.a: I-1,735 linani elinamanani ama-4 yaye i-347×23 ibonakala ingaba linani elinamanani ama-4 nayo, ngoko ibonakala ilunge
y-m-10-02.s.s1.r.a: Ujonge kuphela inyaniso yokuba inani lamanani liyafana. Amanani anamanani ama-4 asusela kakhulu ku-1,000 ukuya ku-9,999, ngoko oku akwanelanga ukugweba ubukhulu.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.o.b: Ukuba uthatha i-347 njengokungabo kumalunga nama-300 kunye nama-23 njengamalunga nama-20, impendulo kufuneka ibe malunga nama-300×20=6,000, ngoko i-1,735 incinci kakhulu
y-m-10-02.s.s1.r.b: Uqale waqikelela ubukhulu obungqongqo ngokutshintsha amanani amabini aphindaphindwayo abe ngamanani asondeleyo emakhulwini namashumini.

y-m-10-02.s.s1.o.d: Ekubeni 7×3=21, inani le-unithi lesiphumo kufuneka libe ngu-1, kodwa i-1,735 iphela ngo-5
y-m-10-02.s.s1.r.d: Usebenzise ipropati yokuba inani le-unithi lesiphumo limiselwa sisiphumo samanani e-unithi.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.explain: b no-d zifikelela kwisigqibo esifanayo (ayiyo i-1,735) ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo. b ihlola ubukhulu yaye d ihlola inani le-unithi. a ithi kuphela inani lamanani liyafana, ngoko ubungqina bayo buthambile, yaye c inokuphinda impazamo efanayo. Ngokuqikelela okanye ukuhlolwa kwenani le-unithi unokuqiniseka ukuba 'ayilunganga', kodwa nokuba idlula zombini, awukwazi ukugqiba ukuba 'ilunge'.

y-m-10-03.title: Amabhokisi ama-apile angama-200
y-m-10-03.topic: Ukutolika ikhwosiyenti kunye nentsalela yokwahlula kunye nentsalela ukuze ihambelane nemeko
y-m-10-03.goal: Qonda ukuba ikhwosiyenti nentsalela efanayo isetyenziswa njengeempendulo ezahlukileyo xa umbuzo utshintsha, uze, ngokwenza amanani anokubakho okwahlula okunekhwosiyenti nentsalela enikiweyo, ujonge imeko ethi 'intsalela incinci kunomahluli'.
y-m-10-03.material: Evenkileni yeziqhamo kukho ii-apile ezingama-200. Ibhokisi e-1 inokubamba ii-apile ezili-12 ubuninzi. 200 yahlulwe nge-12 inikha ikhwosiyenti eyi-16 nentsalela eyi-8 (12×16=192 kwaye 200-192=8).
y-m-10-03.thinking.0: Ukutshintsha okanye ukugcina isigwebo sakho ngokwemeko entsha
y-m-10-03.thinking.1: Ukutolika isiphumo sokubala esifanayo ukuze sihambelane nemeko

y-m-10-03.s.s1.prompt: Landela, ufumana ingcaciso enye ngexesha, ukubona ukuba isiphumo sokubala esifanayo (ikhwosiyenti 16, intsalela 8) sisetyenziswa njani ngokuxhomekeke kumbuzo.

y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uyifunde njengokufaka nee-apile ezi-8 ezisaleyo ebhokisini.

y-m-10-03.s.s2.prompt: Ngeli xesha, masicinge umva. Inani a elinamadijithi amathathu lahlulwe linani b elinamadijithi amabini, kwaye ikhwosiyenti yayi-15 nentsalela yayi-17 (ukwahlula: a ÷ b = 15 … 17). Yenza izibini ezimbini ezinjalo ze-a no-b, ezinamaxabiso ahlukileyo ka-b.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.hint.0: Phinda ubhale “ikhwosiyenti yi-15 nentsalela yi-17” njengo “b ingena amaxesha athile kwaye ethile iyasala,” uze ubhale intetho ye-a usebenzisa b. Emva koko khetha inani elinye lokusebenzisa njenge-b uze wenze a.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.hint.1: Yahlula ngokwenene a oyenzileyo nge-b ukujonga ukuba ufumana ikhwosiyenti eyi-15 nentsalela eyi-17, uze uthelekise intsalela ne-b.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.ok.c3: b ingena amaxesha ayi-15 kwaye eyi-17 iyasala.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.fail.c3: a asilo inani olifumana ngokongeza u-17 ku-b×15. Zama ukwakha a umva ukusuka kwikhwosiyenti nentsalela.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Intsalela eyi-17 inkulu okanye ilingana nomahluli b. Ukuba wahlula ngokwenene kolu lingano, ikhwosiyenti nentsalela ziyatshintsha.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.explain: a yi-b×15+17. Umzekelo, ukuba b=20 ngoko a=317, kwaye 317÷20 inika ikhwosiyenti eyi-15 nentsalela eyi-17. Kodwa, intsalela kufuneka ibe ncinci kunomahluli, ngoko b kufuneka ibe nkulu kuno-17, kwaye ukuze a ibe linani elinamadijithi amathathu, b kufuneka ibe ngu-65 okanye ngaphantsi. Ngoko nawaphi na inani lemvelo b ukusuka kwi-18 ukuya kwi-65 liyasebenza.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.prompt: UMinho wakhetha b=12 no-a=197 wabhala “197 ÷ 12 = 15 … 17”. Bhala isizathu sokuba olu lingano lungabi sisiphumo sokwahlula esichanekileyo, uze ubhale ikhwosiyenti nentsalela yangempela xa u-197 wahlulwa nge-12.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.hint.0: Thelekisa inani elisaleyo emva kokuthatha u-12 kwi-197 amaxesha ayi-15 no-12.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.hint.1: Jonga ukuba ungathatha u-12 ngelinye ixesha kwinani elisaleyo na, uze ubhale ukuba ikhwosiyenti nentsalela zitshintsha njani.

y-m-10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ujonge ikhwosiyenti nentsalela yangempela nge-12×(ikhwosiyenti)+(intsalela)=197?
y-m-10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ubhale ngamazwi akho isizathu sokuba intsalela kufuneka ibe ncinci kunomahluli?
y-m-10-03.s.s3.model.0: Kungenxa yokuba intsalela eyi-17 inkulu kunomahluli u-12. U-12 ungena kwi-17 ngelinye ixesha, ngoko ukuba wenza u-197÷12 ngokwenene, ikhwosiyenti yi-16 kwaye intsalela yi-5.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.model.1: Inani elisalayo emva kokwahlula nge-12 kufuneka libe lincinci kuno-12, kodwa u-17 uyasala, ngoko ungahlula ngelinye ixesha. Ngoko 197 = 12×16 + 5.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.modelNote.1: Isebenzisa 'inani elisalayo' endaweni yegama elithi 'intsalela', kodwa ithetha into efanayo.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.model.2: U-17 mkhulu kuno-12, ngoko u-12 unokususwa ngelinye ixesha, oko kuthetha ukuba akulunganga. 197÷12 inekhwosiyenti eyi-16 nentsalela eyi-5.

y-m-10-06.title: Iirekhodi zeenyanga ezintathu zinokusixelela inyanga elandelayo?
y-m-10-06.topic: Ukubala ngamanqatha ngamanani amakhulu nemida yokuqikelela ngomthetho
y-m-10-06.goal: Qikelela inani elilandelayo ukusuka kwirekhodi ebala ngamanqatha ngama-100,000, kodwa bonisa ngomzekelo ochasayo ukuba iirekhodi ezimbalwa azinakwenza ibe 'ngokuqinisekileyo' injalo, uze wahlule uqikelelo kuqiniseko.
y-m-10-06.material: Ipaki yemidlalo irekhode inani labandwendweli inyanga nenyanga. Iirekhodi zibhalwe kwiiyunithi zabantu abangama-10,000 kuphela, ngoko zihlala ziziziphindaphindi zika-10,000.
